scope: Internal crosswalk from publicly available Boeing supplier-quality requirements/resources to Worldshepherd evidence controls. Applicability to any real Boeing procurement is determined by the actual contract/order and Boeing authority.

sources.title: Boeing Quality Management System Requirements for Suppliers (D6-82479)
sources.bounded_requirement: Boeing defines supplier QMS requirements in D6-82479 appendices/addenda; applicability is contract-defined and Boeing retains assessment/recognition rights.

sources.title: Boeing Clause Q017 — Advanced Product Quality Planning and Production Part Approval Process
sources.bounded_requirement: For indicated contract line items, Q017 requires AS9145 APQP/PPAP artifacts as determined by the Buyer, with artifact sets varying by supplier/design responsibility.

sources.title: Boeing Supplier Quality Surveillance
sources.bounded_requirement: Boeing SQS uses Product Assessment, Quality Process Assessment and Manufacturing Process Assessment in a planned risk/performance-based surveillance process.

sources.title: Boeing Quality Requirements and Information
sources.bounded_requirement: Enterprise resources include approved process sources, Nadcap, SQS, FAI, BQMS, digital product definition and quality clauses.

sqs_crosswalk.boundary: Worldshepherd can organize evidence; Boeing personnel retain Boeing surveillance/acceptance authority.
No Boeing QPA result is inferred from internal checks.
Manufacturing-process conformance requires the applicable Boeing assessment and real process evidence.

machine_rules: contract/order applicability must be explicit before any artifact is called required
artifact requirement state must distinguish REQUIRED, AS_REQUIRED, NOT_APPLICABLE and UNKNOWN
required artifact absence blocks PPAP evidence completeness
a process/design/configuration change invalidates affected downstream artifacts until reassessed
MSA/calibration evidence cannot support release after expiry or unacceptable result
Boeing surveillance/approval status cannot be generated by Worldshepherd
claims_boundary: This crosswalk uses public Boeing material for preparation and software test design. It is not a Boeing-approved interpretation, does not replace AS9145/AS9100/D6-82479/Q017 or the governing contract, and does not establish supplier approval, QMS approval, APQP/PPAP acceptance, SQS results, or product acceptance.
